description_en: Modifies the configuration parameters of a specified community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 变更指定云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群的配置参数
kebab_example:
aliyun clickhouse modify-db-cluster-config-in-xml --db-cluster-id 'cc-bp108z124a8o7****' --config ' debug 1000M 64 4096 300 100 0 10000 0.9 4194304 0 system query_log
ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY event_date ORDER BY event_time TTL event_time + INTERVAL 15 DAY 7500 system query_thread_log
ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY event_date ORDER BY event_time TTL event_time + INTERVAL 15 DAY 7500 0 0 256 100 1 16 6871947673 3435973836 ' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterConfigInXML

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.example:
debug 1000M 64 4096 300 100 0 10000 0.9 4194304 0 system query_log
ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY event_date ORDER BY event_time TTL event_time + INTERVAL 15 DAY 7500 system query_thread_log
ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY event_date ORDER BY event_time TTL event_time + INTERVAL 15 DAY 7500 0 0 256 100 1 16 6871947673 3435973836
parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters to modify. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452210.html operation to query the current configuration parameters. Then, modify the returned parameters.

When you modify a parameter, you must include all other configuration parameters in the request. If a parameter is not included, it retains its initial value or the modification fails
parameters.help_zh:
变更的配置参数。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452210.html接口查询配置参数，对返回的配置参数进行修改。
修改单个参数也需要传入所有的配置参数，未传入的配置参数会保持原值或导致配置参数变更失败
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
